programme.desc: Every war sees new tactics, some inspired, some desperate that try to influence the course of battles: Guadalcanal, Allied Bombing, Dakar, Leningrad, Leyte Gulf, Crete.

programme.title: Visions of War: The Korean War
programme.desc: Depicts the important role of artillery fire in modern warfare.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: James H. Doolittle is discussed, along with other Air Force Commanders.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler and Wagner
programme.desc: From the moment in 1906 when he heard the first note of Lohengrin at Linz opera house until his death in the burning ruins of Berlin in 1945, Hitler was obsessed by the music and mythology of Richard Wagner. The latest research into the often overlooked relationship with musician August Kubizek, his only boyhood friend, has provided clues which have reveal the overwhelming importance of Wagner.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: From the moment Adolf Hitler marched his troops into Poland on the 1st of September 1939, the Second World War was inevitable. As the opening skirmishes are played out, see for yourself the events that shaped the escalating crisis.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As the New Year dawned and the people of Britain faced the introduction of rationing, all eyes turned northwards to Scandinavia. U-Boat attacks increased and at Scapa Flow a German Air Raid claimed the first British casualties.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: The Greatest coordination of arms ever portrayed in the world. Every scene made during the greatest victory of Allied power, to date. 11,000 Allied planes plant their tons of pulverizing bombs on shore installations, strategic roads and bridges, then swoop down to strafe enemy trains, ships and planes. The air poundings continue, and the mop-up search for snipers is on. The invasion is successful.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: French civilians and U.S. Army engineers repair and salvage railroad yards, bridges, and trains.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War
programme.desc: To Adolf Hitler in 1940, Britain was no more than an irritant on his periphery to his rapidly expanding Third Reich. He was correct in his assumption that Britain had been almost fatally weakened by the fight of Dunkirk. If Britain were to be subdued, there seemed to be no more auspicious time than 1940. The Luftwaffe had proven themselves invincible, which filled them with pride and enthusiasm.
programme.sub-title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: Battle of Britain

programme.title: The War In Burma
programme.desc: This military film documents the War in Burma in the South-East Asian theater of World War II.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On September 1, 1939, Germany invaded Poland in a blitzkrieg fueled not only by tactics and technology, but also by Pervitin-crystal meth. Developed in 1938, this 'miracle pill' boosted soldiers' endurance and morale, becoming a weapon of war. Declassified files, including Hitler's medical records, uncover Project D-IX and reveal how meth shaped Nazi power and altered the course of history.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: During this hour, witness the World shaking events that took place of the years immediately preceding WW2. You'll also see the Nazi subjugation of France and England's heroic defense in the Battle of Britain. Pearl Harbor is also discussed.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: The downed 'Messer' crashes in a forest but doesn't explode. Both Germans and Soviet scouts race to recover its night-vision device. Its creator, German scientist Holts, also seeks it, tracking Soviet moves and anticipating the Swallows' aerial reconnaissance. The wreck lies in a swamp, making recovery far more difficult.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: This is the story of the Army's Psychological Warfare activities in the Far East Command, primarily as a tactical weapon in Korea. We augment the effectiveness of our combat forces with the potent weapon of words. Through leaflets, shot by artillery shells or dropped from planes; through radio news and through loudspeakers mounted on tanks and jeeps, we send our messages of truth to the enemy.
programme.sub-title: Big Picture: Truth is Our Defense

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Fighter Aircraft - WWI
programme.desc: Providing exact numbers, specifications, and plenty of facts, Military Aircraft of the 20th Century provides an encyclopedic look at aircrafts used by any military force in the 20th century. This entry discusses the fighters of WWI, like the Nieuport 17, Albatross, Sopwith Camel, Fokker, and many more.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: Before 1941 was half over, the Soviet Union was locked in struggle with Germany. Before the year was out, humanity would be hanging on the fate of Roosevelt's great union, compelled to join the struggle by what he termed 'a date which will live in infamy.'

programme.title: The Bomber: Terror of World War II
programme.desc: The Blitz shook Britain, but the Allies struck back harder with strategic bombing. Technology advanced-radar, gun turrets, and bomb sights changed everything. Civil defenses rose. After Pearl Harbor, the US joined in, bringing more bombers, more power, and a new level of destruction to the war.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: Wehrmacht Major Otto Link seeks revenge on Soviet pilots who foiled his mission and wiped out saboteurs. At HQ he unveils a night-vision device in his Messerschmitt, letting it fly unseen in darkness. The Germans, aware of an imminent Soviet infantry assault on the bridgehead, prepare a deadly surprise for the bombers-an invisible Messer.

programme.title: Sword of Honour
programme.desc: The story is one man's heroic quest to fight for a deep moral cause and to reclaim his manhood after a shattering divorce from society beauty Virginia Troy.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: This episode offers a gripping historical account of the pivotal New Guinea campaign during World War II, highlighting the challenges and ultimate triumph of the Allied forces.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: During WWII, a squadron faces a treacherous airdrome mission. Bordeaux loses film, compromising the op. They celebrate a victory but face danger later. A pilot reveals fatigue and refuses duty. Charged as a coward, he returns home to a different life. War impacts loved ones, and exemptions stir emotions.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On 18 May 1939, the Nazis opened Ravensbrück, the largest women's concentration camp. Of the 130,000 women and children deported, 90,000 died. Through survivor testimonies, expert insights, 3D models, and reconstructions, this film reveals the camp's brutal conditions and the remarkable resilience of those who endured its horrors.
programme.sub-title: Women of Ravensbrück: Inside Nazi Horrors

programme.title: The Reich Underground
programme.desc: Today, many of the half-built facilities have been long-forgotten. With previously unreleased film material and exclusive interviews, the fascinating and dramatic story of the Underground Reich is reconstructed when the Nazis leaders still hoped that the miracle weapons they produced would bring Germany final victory.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia makes an orecchiette with clams and zucchini. Her spaghetti Caruso is made with a hearty sauce of mixed mushrooms, tomatoes, peas and chicken livers.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Sara kicks off with a street food tour in Rome led by American Ex Pat Katie Parla. Then, they perform a Roman hat trick - three pastas starting with the same delicious base: Gricia made with guanciale transforms into Amatriciana by adding tomatoes or Carbonara by adding eggs. In her own kitchen, Sara makes baked penne with prosciutto and Fontina cheese.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Essential Pastas of Rome

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing like pasta to bring Lidia's family to the table. In this episode, Lidia shares some of her favorite pasta dishes including a comforting Baked Rigatoni with Zucchini, a delicious Penne with Ricotta and Mushrooms and one of her personal favorites, Fettuccine with a Clam and Leek Sauce.

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Stellino makes and plates his favorite pasta dishes.
programme.sub-title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Love of Pasta

programme.title: Ciao Italia - Classic Pasta of Liguria
programme.desc: Food writer and book author Laura Schenone brings a unique Ligurian recipe to Mary Ann's kitchen, where together they prepare delicate pasta wafers called Corzetti served in a delicate garlic and olive oil sauce. Mary Ann adds to the fun with Panzoti, an almond-stuffed little ravioli swimming in a butter sauce. Bravissima Laura e Marianna, e bravissima Liguria!

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The CentralTirgus is the biggest covered city food market in Europe. Just aside the Art Nouveau Old Town, we find century-old rye-bread making, grilled lampreys, soviet milk sausages, and hemp butter. Here the best of Latvian traditions are pushed fast-forward into the digital era by young and curious chefs, bloggers, and pop-up restaurants.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Riga

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The old ladies selling their baskets full of vegetables and cheese on the Dolac market in Zagreb bring us back in time. At the market, we go from the breathtaking Mediterranean islands to the Austrian Alps, from freshly caught hake and simple Baltic snacks to internationally awarded cheese and a unique Turkey breed.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Zagreb

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: At the Mercato Centrale in San Lorenzo, one can taste the best food treasures Tuscany has on offer: from the olive oil of the Fiesole hills to the onions of the medieval borough of Certaldo and up to the Natural Reserve of San Marcello with its Tuscan cured meats. Here the simple and genuine tastes are king.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Firenze

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Placed in the middle of Palermo's ancient streets, it is almost difficult to walk. All around there is a swarm of colors and perfumes. There is everything the Mediterranean island, so rich in agricultural traditions, has to offer. Street food here is a must, including dozens of roasted, salted, pickled, and fried specialties one can count on.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Palermo

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Ireland's third-largest city has one of Northern Europe's market gems: The English Market. It supplies high-quality food to affluent English families unlike the Irish market, which no longer exists. The best Irish produce today remains on the island and can be found here.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Cork

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Kapani market is situated just behind the Aristotelous square of the city of Thessaloniki, facing the Aegean Sea. Exploring this market is exploring the city and its history: a tasteful mix of Sephardic, Balkan, Turkish, and Greek delights. All can be found in the intricate streets of the market or tasted at the many cafés and tavernas operating there daily.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Thessaloniki

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores medieval English taverns, inns, and alehouses, each serving different roles and social classes. Taverns sold wine, inns provided lodging, and alehouses were private homes selling ale. The episode covers wine quality control, bread and ale laws, and their reputations for gambling and excess. He recreates bokenade, a beef pottage with saffron, cloves, and verjuice.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What it was like to visit a Medieval Tavern

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores the Old West saloon as a social hub for food and drink. He covers its evolving design, popular beverages like whiskey, beer, champagne, and cocktails, gambling games such as poker, and the famous "free lunch" tradition. The episode highlights regional foods, oysters' popularity, and recreates an 1886 pork and beans recipe from *Cooking for Profit*.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What Food was Served at Wild West Saloons?

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores WWII home front rationing in the U.S., from 1942 sugar limits to the red and blue point system for meat, dairy, and canned goods. He covers price controls, Victory Gardens, labor shortages, internment camps, and black-market "meatleggers." He also recreates Betty Crocker's "emergency steak," a budget-friendly mix of ground beef, cereal, and milk.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Cooking on the American Home Front During WWII

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores Titanic's luxurious first class, from modest suites to lavish parlor suites with private promenades. He covers dining in the saloon and Ritz, daily meals, amenities like the gym and Turkish bath, and the 10+ course final dinner. Using survivor accounts, he recreates the famous peaches in Chartreuse jelly dessert from April 14, 1912.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Dining First Class on the RMS Titanic

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores Titanic's first class breakfast from April 11, 1912, featuring over a dozen dishes by Escoffier. He recreates baked apples, smoked salmon coronets, shirred eggs, and buckwheat cakes with blackcurrant conserve. The episode highlights dining venues, passenger pets, and the tragic story of honeymooners Victor and Maria Josefa Peñasco.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - First Class Breakfast on the RMS Titanic

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores the 4-6 month, 2,200-mile Oregon Trail journey (1846-1869), covering provisions like flour, bacon, and hardtack, cooking over buffalo chips, and staple meals like Johnny cakes. He discusses hunting, trading with Native Americans, celebrations, and hardships, including spoiled food, salt-rising bread, pies, and pioneers leaving possessions at Fort Laramie.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What Pioneers ate on the Oregon Trail

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max recreates Ötzi the Iceman's last meal (c. 3,359-3,105BC), discovered in 1991. He covers Ötzi's clothing, tools, health (tattoos, heart disease, parasites), and likely murder by arrow. Using stomach contents-smoked ibex, charred red deer, and einkorn pancake with fiddle ferns-Max cooks over an open fire to mimic Neolithic methods.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Recreating the Last Meal of Ötzi the Iceman

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max traces airline food from 1919's first commercial meal to aviation's Golden Age (1950s-70s). He covers flight kitchens, cold-to-hot meal evolution, themed flights, flight attendant hiring, the 1958 Great Sandwich War, and 1978 deregulation. Max recreates a 1954 United Airlines meal of pot roast, vegetables, Delmonico potatoes, and marshmallow-apple salad.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Airline Food During the Golden Age of Air Travel

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max recreates Medieval Irish corned beef and cabbage from *The Vision of Mac Con Glinne* (c. 1100) with onion-leek pottage. He explores Ireland's rigid food hierarchy-peasants ate grains and salted meat, butter signified wealth, monks preferred game, nobles had fresh meat-and cultural practices like fosterage, the 7-year child-rearing system, and a satirical poem about King Cathal's gluttony.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Medieval Irish Food: Peasant to King

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores lighthouse keeper life via an 1881 provisioning list and period recipes. He covers the isolated, demanding job-cleaning Fresnel lenses with mercury, trimming wicks, and cooking with limited supplies like flour, beans, and salt pork. Featuring keepers Henry Long, Mary Ryan, and Hannah Thomas, he recreates Fannie Farmer's 1896 Boston corn chowder with pilot bread.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Eating like a Lighthouse Keeper from the 1800's

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann teaches her Scuola Culinaria student, Karen the traditional Italian culinary secrets of creating soft-as-a-cloud, pillowy gnocchi every time. When they're as perfect as these Amalfi-style gnocchi, all that's needed is a buttery, heavy cream sauce of asparagus tips and lemon zest to make you close your eyes, take one taste and swear you're in Amalfi.
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Got Lemons, Make Gnocchi

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: In a matter of minutes, Mary Ann combines sliced chicken breasts with onions, garlic, and turmeric and into the oven it goes to create her husband's recipe Guy's Chicken with Olives and Turmeric. Then she makes another favorite, Meatballs Milan Style. Stuffed with filled with mortadella, beef, and ham and fried to a crunchy crisp, you'll want seconds, thirds, fourths!
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Gaetano's Easy Chicken Casserole

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann and eager Scuola Culinaria student John roll up their sleeves and dive into the essential steps need to create an all-time favorite of favorites, Pizza Margherita. Step by step, sauce by sauce, cheese by cheese learn how to take your pizza all the way from yeast to "Yay!" And they're not done yet, not until they make Fried Dough with Cinnamon and Sugar from yeast to "Yum!"
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Make Pizza with a Friend

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann teams up with Executive Chef David Crinieri to wow her cooking students by exploring the world of perfect pestos. Chef David leads off with a delicate Watercress Pesto tossed with Fresh Spinach Linguine and topped with an Artichoke Crudo. Mary Ann's up next with her signature Broccolini and Artichoke Pesto tossed with Fusilli. Want perfect pesto every time? Try either one-or both!

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia heads to South Carolina to meet the many talented artisans that define Lowcountry. From a basket weaver who is keeping the sweetgrass tradition of the Gullah Geechee people alive, to an intercoastal inspired shrimp recipe served in ironware crafted right down the street. Find out why the Lowcountry is defined by its character as much as it is a spot on the map.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Heritage of the Lowcountry

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels to a festival in the Ozarks where she is teaching a cooking class. We follow her as she prepares and gathers her ingredients - we meet a small town chicken farmer, gather produce at the local farmers market, and set the table at a local textile studio where Georgia learns to dye napkins.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Discover Your Roots

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Join Georgia on an urban foraging expedition and learn from an edible and medicinal plants expert as he and Georgia collect a variety of items during a walk through the neighborhood. From flower studded ice cubes, to honeysuckle tea, to dandelion green salad, Georgia is making the most of what is around her.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Into the Wild

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Women from around the country convene in west Texas for a transformative experience in the wild. During the episode, Georgia teaches viewers about the different cuts of venison and the ways to cook them, as well as how to save money by grinding your own meat. The guests and viewers will leave feeling empowered and with a different perspective on what it is to be a human and an omnivore.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Go West, Young Woman

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia hosts a dinner party at her home in Austin, Texas, focusing on ingredients that are as locally sourced and homemade as possible. Pulling produce from her own garden, she turns it into pickled vegetables, tomato bread salad, a lemon balm cocktail and more! Georgia even decorates the dinner table entirely with items she has found in nature.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Entertaining at Home

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels back to the South of France, where she once cooked at a Michelin restaurant, and spends time in the olive harvest with a family who is carrying on the tradition of making olive oil. We learn about the herbs that are grown by a farmer late in the season to be infused in the olive oil, and how the oil is used by the baker who is baking bread using heirloom wheat.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - France: The Noble Olive

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels to the Rosebud Native American Reservation in South Dakota and spends time with the Lakota people who are pursuing the "7-generation framework" - their vision for the next 150 years. She learns about the work they are doing to reclaim their food sovereignty, their culture and language, to bring their people back to that sacred place of equilibrium that is essential in building a strong and sovereign tribal nation - where they are physically, spiritually, and mentally whole.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - The Lakota Nation: A Story of Empowerment

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia visits the Catskills in New York, where a couple has created a stunning homestead and serves their community through weekly dinners that now attract people from afar. She heads out into the woods, into the root cellar, and into the kitchen with Jake and Elizabeth as they create a beautiful meal for dinner guests. The couple shares how they created this space and offer inspiring ideas for living and entertaining.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - The Bovina Farm and Fermentory Story

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia brings the audience into the kitchen with her to share delicious garden to table recipes. Along the way she pays a visit to an artisan beeswax candle maker who teaches her the art of candle making. Georgia then goes to sit at the pottery wheel with a gifted ceramicist to create candle holders and elements for a table setting.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - From Earth to Art

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane visits a famous local marble sculptor en route to visit an old friend and great cook, where she learns the secrets of pinched sweet cheese cakes, ancient sesame-honey confections and more. Back in her own kitchen, she creates a luscious Tinos-style artichoke bread pudding and red mullet in caper sauce, both Tinos traditional specialties.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Tinos: Ancient Marble, Timeless Flavors

programme.title: A Zulu Christmas
programme.desc: When a city-raised boy is forced to spend Christmas on his grandmothers rural farm, hes in for the culture shock of his life. Will he rediscover his heritage and find a deeper meaning to Christmas?

programme.title: Trapt
programme.desc: When a crew is hired to shoot a horror film, its lights, camera, action, murder! A creepy old house, a reclusive grandmother, and a one-eyed groundskeeper puts everyone on edge but when people begin to disappear, the real nightmare begins.

programme.title: Crimes Uncovered
programme.desc: The terrible tale of the murder of successful musical theatre Legend Taliep Petersen. A mere house robbery on the surface turns out to be a treacherous betrayal at the hands of a supposed loved one.
programme.sub-title: The Ultimate Betrayal: The Taliep Petersen Story

programme.title: Ammo Moses

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: The origins of World War II lie in Asia in 1931; tracing the invasion of 1937 and the Rape of Nanjing; witnessing the events through the eyes of a Chinese soldier and a Japanese journalist, young men who bear witness to the flesh and blood of battle.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: In addition to the story of people, World War II is the story of technology; perhaps nowhere is this more apparent than the tanks Germany uses to barrel across Poland and France in "lightning warfare"; how new technology defeats the old ways of war.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: Wartime Warsaw offers a gateway to the darkest events of the war; bearing witness as the city's Jews are rounded up and put in the ghetto, where the specter of disease and starvation always looms; stories from several of the ghetto's inhabitants.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: In Nazi-occupied France, informants create an environment of paranoia and fear, yet some people offer resistance in ways big and small; revisiting the legacy of the French Resistance to experience life under the Nazi boot.
programme.sub-title: The Small Acts of the French Resistance

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: Shifting one's attention across the English Channel, where Britain faces the Nazi war machine alone; tracing the war in London through the eyes of a Jewish child in the East End, a bureaucrat performing unglamorous duties and a young Oxford student.
programme.sub-title: A Child and a Pilot in the London Blitz

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: When the Nazis set up a siege of Leningrad in 1941, none of the city's inhabitants can envision the impact; finding out what daily life is like inside "the Ring" of besieged Leningrad through the eyes and diaries of three unforgettable women.

programme.title: World War II: Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: Prior to the war, Americans in the Philippines live in a "soldier's paradise"; this changes when the Japanese invade the country; seeing what life is like after the fall of the Philippines, from the Bataan Death March to an internment camp in Manila.
programme.sub-title: The Captured and Pursued in the Philippines

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: The opening lecture presents the main themes of the course; beginning with the concept of total war; other themes include the role of ideology, the meanings ascribed to the war by different sides and the war's legacy.

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: Examining the state of Europe and the world before the onset of the war in 1914; the emergence of the German Empire creates strains in the international balance of power; divided among Great Britain, France, Germany, Austria-Hungary and Russia.

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: Even among those who expect war, there are widespread misconceptions about the nature of the conflict to come; in this lecture, exploring the prevailing ideas and attitudes in Europe; the premonitions noted by contemporaries of coming disaster.
programme.sub-title: Towards Crisis in Politics and Culture

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: This lecture analyzes the immediate events that lead to war; the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria-Hungary at Sarajevo in June 1914; the diplomatic chain reactions that follow in the July Crisis.
programme.sub-title: Causes of the War and the July Crisis, 1914

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: The hysterical celebration known as the August Madness greets the outbreak of war between the Central Powers (Germany and Austria-Hungary) and the Allies (France, Great Britain and Russia); how widespread this emotional outburst really is.

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: This lecture follows the unfolding of the German Schlieffen Plan, which envisions quick victory on two fronts; the French Plan XVII aims to recover lost French territories; both attempts are thwarted.
programme.sub-title: The Failed Gambles - War Plans Break Down

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: The Western Front soon freezes into static trench warfare and horrific slaughter from attempts to break this deadlock; generals on both sides seek a breakthrough that allows sweeping offensives and glorious cavalry charges; these never materialize.

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: A detailed overview of the trench landscape from the perspective of ordinary soldiers; the elaborate fortifications; the omnipresence of death; the codes of behavior such as the Christmas fraternizations between the trenches in 1914.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Toro le dispara a Julia, quien muere en los brazos de Tim. Leonor escucha que la asesinaron para vengar al Güero y acusa a Rawlings. Rutila desespera y decide ir a la guerra contra el Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema impide a la fuerza que Rutila escape con su hijo, mientras Víctor promete no dejar sola a su prima. Feyo y doña Alba siguen juntos, y Luzma le dice a Belén que está enamorada de su papá.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Feyo llega al rancho, y su hija le dice que Belén le monta cuernos con Aurelio. Casillas pide luz verde a Rutila para matar al Chema; también le da pautas a Tim para vengar la muerte de Julia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Feyo estalla de la rabia; le tiende una trampa a Belén para que vaya a casa de Justino y, delante de Aurelio, la amenaza de muerte. Ignacio le pide ayuda a Leonor para liberar a su asistente.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Feyo degüella y manda a enterrar a Belén ante los ojos de Aurelio, y le exige que pida perdón por ensuciar a la mujer que amaba. Casillas se va con Luzma de Michoacán tras la amenaza de Aguilera.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica le dice a Aurelio que no lo quiere ver más, y él les propone a ella y a Esperanza que hagan una despedida los tres. Feyo dice en su rancho que Belén no regresará y prohíbe hablar de ella.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Morejón tiene problemas de bebida, y su esposa y colaboradores están preocupados. Aurelio sufre un fuerte dolor por deficiencia renal. Mónica negocia con Esperanza a espaldas de Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor y Mónica hacen el amor; él no olvida a Chabela, pero quiere que lo ayude a no pensar en ella. Aurelio y Tim buscan un culpable del asesinato de Andrews, y Rivero detiene a Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Cristina, drogada, entra a la fuerza a casa de Víctor, donde Mónica la enfrenta. Furiosa, la periodista le dice a Rutila que se vengará. Leonor no resistiría estar de nuevo presa, y Omar le propone huir.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Desesperada, Mónica le pide ayuda a Omar para huir con su hijo, luego de confesarle a doña Alba que Aurelio es culpable de la muerte de Isabel. Morejón acusa a Ignacio del atentado a Monteverde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba reconoce que Aurelio es un criminal y está decidida a matarlo. Leonor se enfrenta a tiros con Mónica frente al edificio de Omar. Feyo y Casillas viajan a Cancún, dispuestos a vengarse.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El secuestrador hace que Marcado vaya por Luzma, a cambio de trabajar con Aurelio. Rutila se entera de que su hermanita consume metanfetaminas. Morejón le pide a Rivero que retome su cargo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio encuentra a Luzma drogada y bebiendo sin control. Ella lo culpa, le dice que consume la droga que él vende. Alba le dice a Víctor y Rutila que enviará a Carlitos a Colombia con su tía.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor acepta la propuesta de Omar de convertirse en la señora Terán. Rivero no cree que el agente de la DEA asesinó a Andrews, mientras Morán le dice a Tim que él y los Casillas lo mataron.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba amenaza con un arma a Aurelio, y él le pide que lo mate de una vez. Ella no dispara y llama a Feyo para decirle que se cuide. Omar miente, le asegura a Leonor que no conoce a Mónica.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Feyo y Aurelio llegan a Cancún listos para matar. Rutila le confiesa a Rivero que el Chema es el padre de su hijo, y le pide que lo asesine. Begoña consigue drogas en el cuarto de Luciana.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica le revela a Víctor que Aurelio es culpable de la muerte de Isabel y sus hijos, pero él desespera y no quiere creerlo. Feyo acusa a Casillas de soplón, pero dejan su enfrentamiento para luego.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor culpa a Aurelio de la muerte de Chabela y se van a los golpes: le dice a su tío que está con Mónica, que no se atreva a hacerle daño. Feyo y el Chema se asocian y van contra Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Junto a Esperanza, Aurelio se decide por el lavado de dinero y le deja el narcotráfico a Víctor; además, no perdona a Mónica por revelar su secreto. Cristina venderá información de Casillas a Ignacio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ramiro consigue que Aurelio apoye sus planes con Omar para ponerle la mano al poder político, y le revela que Terán y Mónica son primos. Luzma se escapa con el Chef y llegan a casa de Cristina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de una noche de amor con Rutila, el Chema sale de su madriguera para ayudar a Feyo, sin imaginar los planes de Rivero. Mónica convence a Omar para que vaya a la cita con Ramiro Silva.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Omar está aterrado al saber que Ramiro lo escogió para ser presidente de México y que recibirá órdenes de Aurelio. El Chema escapa y hiere a Rivero, mientras Leonor rescata a Rutila y a su hijo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los estudiantes son ejecutados por orden de Feyo, quien, junto con el Chema, busca matar a los Casillas. Aurelio entrega su imperio a Mónica y Víctor. Rutila encuentra el dinero para huir.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le cobra con sangre a Cristina su traición, y la mata frente a Esperanza, mientras le jura a Feyo que se vengará por lo que le hizo a Alba. Tim captura al general venezolano en Aruba.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En un atentado organizado por Aurelio para levantar la candidatura de Omar, Ignacio mata a Leonor en un acto de campaña. Pasan dos años, la salud de Casillas se deteriora y reúne a su familia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema y Feyo atacan a la familia Casillas y Luzma queda gravemente herida. Mónica está embarazada de Víctor, mientras él es víctima de una emboscada en Colombia, traicionado por Tijeras.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Para vengarse de Feyo, Aurelio visita en la cárcel a María Sol y lo llama para que escuche cuando la ahorca. Desesperado, Aguilera advierte que matará a todos los Casillas. Javi salva a Víctor.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrés quiere la custodia de su hermanita de ocho años; su madre la sometió a una cirugía plástica. Carlos quiere cortarse el miembro; su esposa Fabiola exige que se someta a terapia psicológica.
programme.sub-title: Cirugías plásticas para niños; Odio a mi penecito

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La esposa de Osmany quiere el divorcio, su cuñada, que reconozca a su hija y la mantenga, y su suegra, lanza una acusación. A Cintia le encanta el sexo oral, pero su esposo ya no puede más.
programme.sub-title: Tres mujeres para un hombre; Bajar a la fuente

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cristian pide la custodia de su hijo, la mamá trata la diabetes del niño con saliva de reptil. José quiere desalojar a Valerie, estudiante venezolana de acogida, ella lo acusa de estafador.
programme.sub-title: Gila Lizard Monster; Trampa a estudiantes Venezuela

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Ratoncito explorador; Hija en coma, madre embarazada

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cristal descubre que su esposo se viste de mujer y su medio hermano se lleva a su sobrina, ella lo acusa de no devolvérsela. Alexis pide ayuda para Cristopher, que está obsesionado con el fuego.
programme.sub-title: Nelson ahora mamá; Reto del fuego para likes

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alejandra demanda al padre de sus hijos por darles alcohol, tabaco y drogas, él alega que solo los educa. Belén exige que su esposo desaloje a su amante, él se aprovechó de su depresión.
programme.sub-title: Nicotina para niños; Infiel por inmigración

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Damil demanda a la viuda de su fallecido hermano. Stacy la echó de la casa porque se enamoró de ella. Raquel está cansada de que Clemente, su novio, la obligue a disfrazarse para tener sexo.
programme.sub-title: Lesbiana tía hermana del muerto; Fantasías con la Dra. Polo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alejandra exige 100 mil dólares, su hija mató a su instructor por la negligencia del dueño del campo de tiro. Vivi pide desalojar a Cristopher, el amante de su marido, no lo quiere en su casa.
programme.sub-title: Niña mata instructor de armas; Amor de prisión

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Annette exige el divorcio, su esposo está obsesionado con un batido que lo convirtió en infiel. Carolina pide la custodia de su sobrina, sus hermanos afirman que sus intenciones no son buenas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tania demanda a Pamela por anular el contrato de vientre subrogado, pero la acusan de consumir droga. Jonathan exige que su exesposa lo indemnice por esconder sus bienes durante el divorcio.
programme.sub-title: LSD por los ojos; Los dos con amantes

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jorge le exige a su esposa Pamela que acepte a su bebé, ella rechaza al niño porque es negro. Luis pide la custodia de sus hijos, afirma que la mamá está incapacitada, el cáncer la dejó calva.
programme.sub-title: Esperma negra; Niña de seis años ve a mamá con quimio

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nataly quiere anular su matrimonio con Claudia, ella la engañó y no le dio los papeles. A Javier lo deportan y pierde a sus hijos, regresa a buscarlos, pero su cuñado no quiere entregárselos.
programme.sub-title: Mi mujer no me dio la residencia; Padre indocumentado busca a sus hijos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Adalberto exige la custodia de su hijo adolescente, lo acosan por ser gay y quiere suicidarse. Andrés acusa a su esposa de envenenar a la familia con la tecnología e intenta proteger a su hija.
programme.sub-title: Quince años se ahorca por gay; Vida sin tecnología

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Amante de sacerdote; Senos con feo olor

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Asociación A.M.A; Manager lucra de videos porno

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Danza Butoh; Romeo y Julieta callejeros

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paula es adicta a la crema de mentol y la usa en todo su cuerpo, pero la crema le causó daño a su esposo y ahora él la demanda. Fabiola se convirtió al cristianismo y por eso le pide el divorcio a su pareja.
programme.sub-title: Amor al mentol; Todo es gracias a Dios

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Por haberle transmitido sida, Sara le pide 500 mil dólares a Geovanny y la lista de las personas con las que ha tenido sexo. Claudia lo ataca con un machete, él la demanda por 50 mil dólares.
programme.sub-title: Va contagiando VIH; Babalawo recibe machetazos de esposa

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Viviana descubrió que su padre está muerto y no la abandonó como su madre dijo. También se dio cuenta de que esta ya se gastó toda la herencia que dejó el difunto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Diana dice que su esposo cambió cuando la vio parir, ella cree que él es gay. Ahora pide la custodia de su hija y 25 mil dólares. Cynthia despide a César por fumar marihuana, él pide ser indemnizado.
programme.sub-title: Traumado por ver a mujer parir; Marihuana o deshabilitado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: El hijo del sicario; Muerte segura

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Ver en el baño inspira; Papá por Facebook

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Mellizas con diferentes padres; Látex contra el cigarrillo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Renata estaba embarazada de gemelos con un donante de esperma, pero uno de los bebés nació muerto y ahora se pelean por el otro. Rolando teme que su sobrina mate a su madre, por eso pide que se vaya.
programme.sub-title: Mi bebé murió, quiero el tuyo; Mi sobrina Génesis

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Heterosexual por un año; Anguila, el electricista

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.desc: Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky is looking for Po. He looks for her everywhere, but she is hiding from him. When he finds her all the Tubbies dance a happy dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Childhood fear is pure, untempered by adult rationality. After his divorce, Steven LaChance dismisses his children's nightmares as stress-until he experiences chilling disturbances himself. Shadows lurk, screams echo, and an unseen force preys on them. He flees, but when another family moves in, he vows to help them. If you enter the spirit world, the spirits enter yours.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When Sidney's girlfriend moves in, he and his mother, Jaime, experience disturbing events, escalating from eerie calls to physical attacks. They soon discover an ex-friend is using witchcraft to tear them apart. As Jaime becomes the target of a deadly assault, the family, fearing for their lives, seeks the help of paranormal investigators before the dark forces succeed in their sinister plan.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After Candace and John St. Clair visit a haunted tunnel where slaves were buried alive, something follows them home. Their daughter has terrifying nightmares, dishes shatter, and the entity soon turns violent. Attacked and terrified, they call paranormal experts to cleanse their home-before they're forced to flee from the malevolent presence.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In 2012, Amanda Morrisson and her family clean a relative's home to fund his care but uncover satanic objects. Soon, they face terrifying events-Nate sees shadows, David has nightmares, and Alliah spirals into depression. When Amanda encounters a sinister entity, they seek a demonologist, who traces the haunting to an evil necklace David took from the house.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Stacy Jones feels confident letting her son Jamie join her at a cemetery investigation. But after returning home, Jamie finds strange scratches on his leg and experiences terrifying activity-objects flying and unseen forces attacking him. When Stacy witnesses a demonic assault on her son, she calls in expert John Zaffis to help save Jamie from possession.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In 2012, Olivia and Jesse Barbour's daughter Marie befriends a boy named Jackson-who isn't real. At first harmless, Jackson soon frightens Marie, leaving bruises and urging her to follow him to heaven. When she's found with red marks on her neck, the family seeks help. Investigators reveal Jackson is a cruel spirit-an old man disguised as a boy to torment Marie.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: While preparing their late friend Paul's house for sale, Anita Intenzo and her son Chris encounter his spirit-along with something much darker. When a violent entity attacks Chris, Anita seeks help. A medium warns of a demon linked to a mysterious artifact Paul acquired abroad. As chaos erupts in their home, Anita and Chris must locate the artifact before the demon destroys them.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Latin jazz guitarist Eddie Benitez moves to Arizona to revive his career, but his home is haunted. Strange occurrences escalate when his son falls mysteriously ill. With no medical explanation, Eddie discovers the room was the site of a horrific suicide. Fearing the spirit is slowly killing his son, Eddie turns to his Puerto Rican roots to battle the deadly entity before it's too late.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Fahey family has lived in their Galway townhouse for decades. When Martha brings home her newborn, eerie disturbances begin. Unexplained cries echo through the night, objects vanish, and a chilling presence fills the house. A priest offers no relief, but a healer reveals a dark secret-Martha's child has awakened the psychic energy of a long-buried crime that prayer alone cannot erase.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After rejecting a friend's advances, Stephanie Winters is cursed. Soon, in their new Virginia home, she and her husband experience strange noises and objects moving. When the entity violently scratches and chokes Stephanie, they seek help. A paranormal investigator suspects a demonic ritual, leading them to a demonologist and the church to battle the dark force before it destroys Stephanie.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: North Carolina natives Jamie and Aaron live a 'perfect' Southern lifestyle until a dark entity begins communicating with and terrifying their children. The family risks ridicule by neighbors and family when they call paranormal experts to the rescue.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Modern science suggests we are all connected by energy. This may explain why Romie feels drawn to an abandoned house in Tucson, Arizona. After moving in, nightmares bleed into reality, and she sees a shadowy spirit. A clairvoyant urges her to communicate with it, but fear holds her back. As the entity targets only her, Romie begins to question her sanity-is the house haunted, or is she cursed?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Jennifer Hoke and fiancé Jamie Jones find their dream home in Pensacola, FL, but something dark lurks within. Strange noises and shadows soon escalate to violent attacks. Jamie is pulled from bed, and the family is trapped in terror. Seeking answers, they turn to a local empath, who uncovers a history more sinister than they ever imagined.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: John Drenner Jr. unknowingly unleashes a demon after finding a satanic bible in an abandoned shack. Plagued by violent attacks and nightmares, he spirals into depression. Just as the entity threatens to claim his life, he finds hope in a young woman who helps him seek deliverance. With time running out, exorcist Bill Bean must act fast to drive out the demon before it's too late.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Taylor Jones reconnects with her estranged mother, Joyce, unaware of the darkness she brings. When Taylor finds Joyce practicing black magic in her daughter's room, she cuts ties-but it may be too late. Isabelle soon has an invisible friend, then grows terrified to be alone. As the haunting escalates, a paranormal team uncovers a tragic past in the attic, trapping tormented souls forever.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: It's said that every photograph steals a piece of a soul. What happens when the subject is dead? Lisa becomes obsessed with a photo of her boyfriend's brother, killed in Vietnam. As her fixation deepens, she experiences waking visions of the soldier and believes the picture has a life of its own. When her daughters report supernatural encounters, Lisa realizes the spirit is taking control.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Sam Baltrusis' séance performance leaves him possessed and desperate for safety. A Shaman battles the spirit, so Sam can regain control of his life.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Mark Corvo rents out rooms in his childhood home, dismissing strange noises as quirks of an old house. But when a tenant, Ashley, dabbles in dark arts, sinister activity intensifies. A paranormal team confirms a portal has been opened. Mark, an empath, is targeted by dark forces and nearly dies after being pushed from his roof. After recovering, he learns to manage his gift and protect his home.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: When ghosts confront Zoe Dei, she makes the harrowing discovery that her home harbors a paranormal portal which has awakened her dormant ability as psychic medium, forcing her to learn how to live with her newfound ability to see the dead.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In life, people can be tormented by their own crimes. The same may be true in death. In Wilder, Kentucky, a nightclub stands by the Licking River, said to draw murderers and Satanists. Club owner Bobby Mackey dismisses the legends-until his wife and an employee are attacked by unseen forces. Beneath the club, an old slaughterhouse well harbors an ancient evil, waiting to claim its next victims.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After James Hilton and his girlfriend Sandy bring an antique cabinet into their home, they capture actual video evidence proving it's haunted. Sandy fears the entity from the cabinet is taking James over and turns to paranormal investigators for aid.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Kim and Craig settle into their dream home in Bagley, Iowa, but eerie encounters shake their peace. Kim senses an intruder, and her daughter befriends a strange man-one no one else can see. When the unseen entity turns violent, a paranormal investigator confirms the presence of a vengeful spirit. Desperate to protect their family, they turn to a demonologist to drive out the ghost.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Newlyweds Bill and Myrisa Spencer move into a renovated apartment, eager for a fresh start. But ghostly figures soon roam the halls, and their dream home turns into a nightmare. Unable to break their lease, they endure the hauntings-until a violent attack on Bill forces them to seek help. With local ghost hunters, they uncover the building's dark past and the entities that still linger.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Joy expects a fun girls' trip to a haunted plantation, but after returning home, a sinister spirit torments her children. When she sees its face in a trip photo, she realizes the entity is attached to her-not the plantation. As the spirit grows more aggressive, a determined paranormal investigator helps Joy uncover a terrifying past connection and fight to save her family.
